15: export function dataExport () {
16:   return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
17:     try {
18:       const loggedInUser = security.authenticatedUsers.get(req.headers?.authorization?.replace('Bearer ', ''))
19:       if (loggedInUser?.data?.email && loggedInUser.data.id) {
20:         const username = loggedInUser.data.username
21:         const email = loggedInUser.data.email
22:         const updatedEmail = email.replace(/[aeiou]/gi, '*')
23: 
24:         let memories, orders, reviews
25:         try {
26:           memories = await MemoryModel.findAll({ where: { UserId: req.body.UserId } })
27:         } catch (error) {
28:           next(error)
29:           return
30:         }
31: 
32:         try {
33:           orders = await db.ordersCollection.find({ email: updatedEmail })
34:         } catch (error) {
35:           next(new Error(`Error retrieving orders for ${updatedEmail}`))
36:           return
37:         }
38: 
39:         try {
40:           reviews = await db.reviewsCollection.find({ author: email })
41:         } catch (error) {
42:           next(new Error(`Error retrieving reviews for ${updatedEmail}`))
43:           return
44:         }
45: 
46:         const userData:
47:         {
48:           username?: string
49:           email: string
50:           orders: Array<{
51:             orderId: string
52:             totalPrice: number
53:             products: ProductModel[]
54:             bonus: number
55:             eta: string
56:           }>
57:           reviews: Array<{
58:             message: string
59:             author: string
60:             productId: number
61:             likesCount: number
62:             likedBy: string
63:           }>
64:           memories: Array<{
65:             imageUrl: string
66:             caption: string
67:           }>
68:         } =
69:         {
70:           username,
71:           email,
72:           memories: memories.map((memory: MemoryModel) => ({
73:             imageUrl: req.protocol + '://' + req.get('host') + '/' + memory.imagePath,
74:             caption: memory.caption
75:           })),
76:           orders: orders.map((order: {
77:             orderId: string
78:             totalPrice: number
79:             products: ProductModel[]
80:             bonus: number
81:             eta: string
82:           }) => ({
83:             orderId: order.orderId,
84:             totalPrice: order.totalPrice,
85:             products: [...order.products],
86:             bonus: order.bonus,
87:             eta: order.eta
88:           })),
89:           reviews: reviews.map((review: {
90:             message: string
91:             author: string
92:             product: number
93:             likesCount: number
94:             likedBy: string
95:           }) => ({
96:             message: review.message,
97:             author: review.author,
98:             productId: review.product,
99:             likesCount: review.likesCount,
100:             likedBy: review.likedBy
101:           }))
102:         }
103: 
104:         const emailHash = security.hash(email).slice(0, 4)
105:         for (const order of userData.orders) {
106:           challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.dataExportChallenge, () => { return order.orderId.split('-')[0] !== emailHash })
107:         }

109:       } else {

111:       }

114:     }
115:   }

14: const sleep = async (ms: number) => await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

16: export function likeProductReviews () {
17:   return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
18:     const id = req.body.id
19:     const user = security.authenticatedUsers.from(req)
20:     if (!user) {
21:       return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' })
22:     }
23: 
24:     try {
25:       const review = await db.reviewsCollection.findOne({ _id: id })
26:       if (!review) {
27:         return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found' })
28:       }
29: 
30:       const likedBy = review.likedBy
31:       if (likedBy.includes(user.data.email)) {
32:         return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Not allowed' })
33:       }
34: 
35:       await db.reviewsCollection.update(
36:         { _id: id },
37:         { $inc: { likesCount: 1 } }
38:       )
39: 
40:       // Artificial wait for timing attack challenge
41:       await sleep(150)
42:       try {
43:         const updatedReview: Review = await db.reviewsCollection.findOne({ _id: id })
44:         const updatedLikedBy = updatedReview.likedBy
45:         updatedLikedBy.push(user.data.email)
46: 
47:         const count = updatedLikedBy.filter(email => email === user.data.email).length
48:         challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.timingAttackChallenge, () => count > 2)
49: 
50:         const result = await db.reviewsCollection.update(
51:           { _id: id },
52:           { $set: { likedBy: updatedLikedBy } }
53:         )
54:         res.json(result)
55:       } catch (err) {
56:         res.status(500).json(err)
57:       }
58:     } catch (err) {
59:       res.status(400).json({ error: 'Wrong Params' })
60:     }
61:   }
62: }

80:   tokenOf: function (user: UserModel) {
81:     return user ? this.idMap[user.id] : undefined
82:   },
83:   from: function (req: Request) {
84:     const token = utils.jwtFrom(req)
85:     return token ? this.get(token) : undefined
86:   },
87:   updateFrom: function (req: Request, user: ResponseWithUser) {
88:     const token = utils.jwtFrom(req)
89:     this.put(token, user)
90:   }
91: }

97: export const generateCoupon = (discount: number, date = new Date()) => {
98:   const coupon = utils.toMMMYY(date) + '-' + discount
99:   return z85.encode(coupon)
100: }
101: 
102: export const discountFromCoupon = (coupon?: string) => {
103:   if (!coupon) {
104:     return undefined
105:   }
106:   const decoded = z85.decode(coupon)
107:   if (decoded && (hasValidFormat(decoded.toString()) != null)) {
108:     const parts = decoded.toString().split('-')
109:     const validity = parts[0]
110:     if (utils.toMMMYY(new Date()) === validity) {
111:       const discount = parts[1]
112:       return parseInt(discount)
113:     }
114:   }
115: }
116: 
117: function hasValidFormat (coupon: string) {
118:   return coupon.match(/(JAN|FEB|MAR|APR|MAY|JUN|JUL|AUG|SEP|OCT|NOV|DEC)[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}/)
119: }
